messages:
mara: Quick follow-up on the streaming retry RFC — we need to pick a default commit semantics for the gateway. Two contending models: early-commit (ack as soon as request accepted) vs end-commit (commit after full stream finishes).

jordan: Early-commit = simpler billing & tracing but opens side-effect duplication on retries. End-commit safer for side effects but complicates tail-latency & buffering.

samir: We should consider a hybrid: ack at accept but attach a Replay-Key so downstream can dedupe. If a retry happens within window, route to replay handler.

alex: Tbh the replay handler is tricky for large streaming outputs. It needs K/V checkpoints or content-addressed chunks.

samir: Agreed. Minimal API proposal for headers:
```
X-Replay-Key: 8f3a2bfa-3d9e-4c2b-9a1d-9f7b6e5a1234
X-Commit-Mode: early|deferred
Replay-Window-S: 30
```
Also an observability tag so we can trace replays (replay_id, origin_ts).

mara: @alex @jordan does anyone have strong objections to defaulting to early commit + replay-key with a 30s window? Keeps latency low and gives a dedupe path for side-effecting callers. :thinking_face: 

alex: Concern: multi-tenant memory for checkpoints. We can't keep in-memory checkpoints per stream for N tenants. Need bounded retention + eviction. Offload large payloads to cheap object store and keep pointers in gateway.

jordan: +1 to offload. Also add a graceful fallback: if replay storage is unavailable, gateway should switch that request to deferred commit and emit a high-severity metric so SRE sees it.

deploy-bot: rollout queued to staging group 'gateway-replay' — canary 10% in 15m :rocket: 

mara: Action items: samir to draft the header spec + replay-handler contract (include dedupe semantics and idempotency guarantees); alex to prototype offload-pointer format and eviction policy; jordan to add the fallback metric & alert runbook. We'll sync next arch check-in. :+1:
